title: Baanu kehti hai Khudaaya kya karoon
body:
Baanu kehti hai Khudaaya kya karoon
Aa rahaa hai yaad bachcha kya karoon
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaisey neend aayegi jalti reyth par
Meri goudhi hai na jhoola kya karoon
<<DIVIDER>>
Dil kay jo armaan thay dil mein rehgaye
Hogayaa hai goudh soonaa kya karoon
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghutniyoun chaltay na dekha laal ko
Thi badi is ki tamannaa kya karoon
<<DIVIDER>>
Khoon bhari soorath teri nazroun mein hai
Moonh ko aathaa hai kaleija kya karoon
<<DIVIDER>>
Aao Asghar aao maa hai muntazir
Tum bathaao jee kay tanhaa kya karoon
<<DIVIDER>>
Saaheb-e-aulaad bathlaayein zaraa
Mein jhulaa kay khaali jhoola kya karoon
